+# Test cases
+test_cases = [
+    # Original working code
+    '''class Grammar:
+    x
+    def parse():
+        y
+        parser(
+        )
+        z''',
+    
+    # Code with syntax error
+    '''class Grammar:
+    x
+    def parse():
+        y
+        parser(
+finally ;
+        )
+        z''',
+        
+    # Another test case with different indentation pattern
+    '''class Grammar:
+    x
+    def parse():
+        y
+        parser(
+invalid_token
+        )
+        z'''
+]
+
+# Load the grammar
+grammar = parso.load_grammar(version="3.12")
+
+for i, code in enumerate(test_cases):
+    print(f"\n=== Test Case {i+1} ===")
+    try:
+        tree = grammar.parse(code)
+        print("Parsed successfully")
+        # Count error nodes/leaves
+        def count_errors(node):
+            count = 0
+            if hasattr(node, 'type') and 'error' in str(node.type).lower():
+                count += 1
+            if hasattr(node, 'children'):
+                for child in node.children:
+                    count += count_errors(child)
+            elif 'Error' in node.__class__.__name__:
+                count += 1
+            return count
+        
+        error_count = count_errors(tree)
+        print(f"Number of error nodes/leaves: {error_count}")
+        
+        # Check for reported errors
+        errors = list(grammar.iter_errors(tree))
+        print(f"Number of reported errors: {len(errors)}")
+        
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"Failed to parse: {e}")
